items: Be careful with late-night check-ins. Guests arriving past midnight can be more prone to issues. Make sure your self-check-in instructions are clear and foolproof to avoid urgent calls in the middle of the night.

items: Don’t accept change requests to avoid cancellation fees. Some guests send reservation change requests (like reducing the number of nights) just to dodge cancellation penalties. Declining these and sticking to your policy protects your income.
